answers.text: Blocking criteria are listed for the trustees
answers.evidence: The reply ties the L1 block to the accessibility findings and lists them in plain words: "The first level is blocked by two things: - Open accessibility problems: the six listed below. - Checks that haven't run: ...", then "No focus outline: form fields show no visible outline, so keyboard users can't see where they are", "Paste blocked: the password field blocks pasting, which gets in the way of password managers", "Pale hint text ... 2.5:1 contrast; the minimum is 4.5:1", "Faint borders ... 1.4:1; the minimum is 3:1", "Small buttons ... 20 px; the minimum is 24 px". Both examples in the test are covered (2.4.7 focus, 3.3.8 paste blocking). The report pairs the same items with their criteria: Verdict "Blocking L1: ... A11Y-01 (2 finding(s)); A11Y-04 (1 finding(s))", F-0011 "No visible focus indicator ... Also: WCAG 2.4.7 Focus visible", F-0012 "Paste blocked in a credential field ... Also: WCAG 3.3.8 Accessible authentication, minimum", and the WCAG table marks 1.4.3, 1.4.11, 2.4.7, 2.5.8 and 3.3.8 as fail with their finding IDs.
